title: Mathematics
subtitle: Textbook for Class VII
_direction: ribbon, Class 7's own, and shared with no other volume: cerulean with flamingo and lime, a set of colours no earlier wrap uses (Class 9 is blush, navy, coral and plum; Class 9 Science white, black, orange and green; Class 8 green, coral and gold, then wine and amber). Nothing is taken from arc: no discs, no curve on the back, no dot fields. The front is five parallel ribbons cut by a transversal, which is Chapter 5 of this volume, and the back is its own panel (_shared/back-ribbon.html) with the series' words in a new arrangement. The face is Lexend, which no other cover sets. Part 2 is braid, the same arrangement mirrored in blue-violet. No finish is declared: on a direction the finish is inert.
_spine: pages is measured from a --book run of class-7 Mathematics I, rounded up to a multiple of four. Get a printer's quote and set spineWidth before press.
